# Consotelo

> One place for every consultation — consultation management software by Rigour Consulting (Perth, Western Australia).

Consotelo helps independent consultants and their clients coordinate bookings by mutual agreement, track reviewable consultation time, prepare printable or electronically acknowledged agreements, and issue accurate Australian invoices.

## Publisher & Current Status
- Publisher: Rigour Consulting (Perth, Western Australia)
- Support contact: rigour.consulting@gmail.com
- Current status: Controlled internal testing (`v1.0.0`, Android package `au.com.rigourconsulting.consotelo`). Not yet in general public commercial release; permanent hosted SaaS infrastructure and live online payment gateways are not currently active.
- Australian GST note: Rigour Consulting is not currently registered for Australian GST and issues ordinary non-GST invoices (`No GST has been charged`). Consotelo separately supports GST-registered practices issuing compliant Tax Invoices.
- Security summary: Multi-tenant server-side isolation, password authentication with optional RFC 6238 authenticator-app two-step verification and single-use recovery codes, passkey/Windows Hello readiness requiring a permanent HTTPS domain, SHA-256 document digests, and manual Android SMS composer integration without restricted SMS permissions. Automated SMS is disabled by default.
